title: MY FAVORITE YOUTUBERS CTFXC & PVP - Life After College Vlog: Ep 1
description:
Hello Internet! Here is my daily Vlog focusing on my life after graduating from college. This is a prominent point in my life, as I believe it is in most anybody's. 

In this first episode, I focus on my favorite YouTube Vloggers CTFxC with Charles and Ali Trippy, and PVP (Prank Vs Prank) with Jesse and Jeana. 

Additional Features of this Episode: 
- Super Smash Bros Characters
- How to cook Ramen
- Chipotle should hide their napkins from me
- Friends TV show
- Awkward Silence Game
- 3 Things I Wish I Knew About Life After College
author: VlogAfterCollege
